_note: The proposals that are not about the deficit: two that move money in opposite directions, one that binds a spending line, and the one that makes the bloc act as a single power against the nations outside it. See docs/bloc-model.md.

proposals.name: Cohesion Fund Expansion
proposals.summary: A larger common fund for the bloc's poorer regions, paid for by a higher call on every member's budget.

proposals.name: Recovery and Resilience Facility
proposals.summary: Joint borrowing against the bloc's own credit, disbursed to members as investment grants. Cheaper than borrowing alone, and it is the bloc's balance sheet that carries it.

proposals.name: Common External Tariff
proposals.summary: The bloc levies as one on goods entering from outside it. Every member's customs post charges the same rate, and no member sets its own.
